ai.title: Remove cheerio, add raw.githubusercontent.com direct fetch
ai.summary: Removed `cheerio` dependency from `npm-app/package.json` and `npm-app/src/web-scraper.ts`. `scrapeWebPage` now detects `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/` URLs and fetches them directly via `axios`, bypassing the `https://r.jina.ai/` proxy used for other pages. This change is scoped to the web scraper subsystem in the npm app.

eli5.text: When the assistant tries to read a plain-text file hosted on GitHub (a raw file URL), it now downloads that file directly instead of sending it through a separate reading service. For all other web pages, the existing route through the reading service is still used. Visitors who paste a GitHub raw file link should see the file contents load the same way as before, just fetched via a more direct path.

ai.title: Replace o1 with o3-mini in planning and cost tracking
ai.summary: Switched the thinking model from o1 to o3-mini (o3-mini-2025-01-31) in planning.ts and constants.ts. Updated message-cost-tracker.ts with new input/output token rates for o3-mini and added cached_tokens handling in openai-api.ts to subtract cache reads from input tokens. Removed costMode 'max' gating for plan_complex_change in system-prompt.ts and main-prompt.ts, making planning tool usage universal.

eli5.text: The assistant will now think through requests using a faster, cheaper model called o3-mini instead of the older, more expensive o1, so you'll see it start planning tasks a bit quicker without waiting as long during the thinking step. The cost numbers the system tracks for this thinking model have been lowered and made visible alongside the other models, and the tool that breaks big jobs into steps is now offered to you all the time instead of only on the priciest plan. If you look, you won't see any of these settings directly, but you may notice planning messages finish more promptly and the plan suggestion appear regardless of which pricing tier you're on.

ai.title: Add reasoningEffort option to OpenAI backend
ai.summary: OpenAI backend gains `reasoningEffort` parameter. Default `medium` replaces hardcoded `high`. `planning.ts` explicitly sets `high` for o3-mini.

eli5.text: The assistant now controls how deeply it thinks before answering, instead of always thinking the hardest. Most requests settle for a medium level of reasoning effort, but one specific advanced model used for planning still works at the highest depth. If you looked, you'd see the assistant using the same powerful model for tricky tasks but spending less thinking time on everyday questions.

ai.title: Remove forced agent mode bypass after planning
ai.summary: Removed conditional bypass for `checkToAllowUnboundedIteration` when `assistantIsExecutingPlan` is true in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Agent mode is no longer forced after planning. Added `start-codebuff-test` script to `package.json`.

eli5.text: When you asked the assistant to plan a complex change, it used to be forced to stay in a long-running 'agent' mode afterward, letting it take many back-to-back actions until you stopped it. Now that forced mode is turned off after planning: the assistant no longer gets carted off into unbounded auto-working just because it finished laying out a plan, so you're back to normal turn-by-turn interaction right away. If you looked, you'd see the assistant simply returns control to you after a plan instead of spinning into extended automated action. A separate helper script was also added for running local tests, but that only affects developers setting things up on their machines.
